newsitem.title: USA: President Casino suspends riverboat gaming.
newsitem.headline: President Casino suspends riverboat gaming.

text.p: President Casinos Inc said Wednesday it had suspended operations aboard its riverboat facility in Davenport, Iowa, due to rising waters on the Mississippi River.
It said flood waters are also negatively affecting its St. Louis operations, but does not foresee suspending operations there, based on most recent estimates of state and local officials.
It said it suspended its Davenport operations at 6 p.m. on April 14. Although it does not expect the suspension to be prolonged, it said it cannot predict at this time when it can resume operations.
It said it has business interruption insurance which covers losses arising from such events.
